description: 20 targeted claims verifying fixed defects remain stable and unregressed.

cases.claim: Tesla Cybertruck was recalled in April 2024 because the accelerator pedal pad could become trapped

reference.passage: Tesla is recalling certain 2024 Cybertruck vehicles. When high force is applied to the pad on the accelerator pedal, the pad may dislodge, which may cause the pedal to become trapped in the interior trim.

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Official NHTSA filing confirms exact defect and recall date.

cases.claim: Tesla Cybertruck accelerator pedal recall in April 2024 was caused by a nuclear reactor explosion

reference.passage: An unapproved change introduced lubricant to aid in the component assembly of the pad onto the accelerator pedal, causing reduced retention of the pad to the pedal.

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Directly contradicted by official cause: assembly soap lubricant, not nuclear explosion.
cases.evidence_limitations: Absurd causal attribution directly contradicted by engineering documentation.

cases.claim: Apple released the Vision Pro spatial computer in the United States on February 2, 2024

reference.passage: CUPERTINO, Calif. — Jan. 8, 2024 — Apple today announced Apple Vision Pro will be available beginning Friday, February 2, at all U.S. Apple Store locations and the U.S. Apple Store online.
reference.claim_context: Apple Official Vision Pro Release Announcement

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Official Apple release date confirmed as February 2, 2024 in the US.

cases.claim: Apple released the Vision Pro spatial computer in 1995

reference.passage: Apple today announced Apple Vision Pro will be available beginning Friday, February 2, 2024.
reference.claim_context: Apple Official Vision Pro Release Announcement

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Contradicts product launch date by nearly three decades.

cases.claim: Nvidia was founded in 1993 by Jensen Huang, Chris Malachowsky, and Curtis Priem

reference.passage: 1993: NVIDIA is founded by Jensen Huang, Chris Malachowsky, and Curtis Priem.

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Official corporate timeline confirms founders and founding year 1993.

cases.claim: Nvidia was founded in 2022 by anonymous internet developers

reference.passage: 1993: NVIDIA is founded by Jensen Huang, Chris Malachowsky, and Curtis Priem.

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Directly contradicted by Nvidia corporate history.

cases.claim: Sundar Pichai was appointed CEO of Alphabet in December 2019 while retaining his role as CEO of Google

reference.passage: Item 5.02: Larry Page and Sergey Brin have stepped down from their respective roles as CEO and President of Alphabet. Sundar Pichai will become the CEO of Alphabet while remaining the CEO of Google.

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Official SEC 8-K filing confirms appointment in December 2019.

cases.claim: Larry Page is currently the active Chief Executive Officer of Alphabet

reference.passage: Larry Page and Sergey Brin have stepped down from their respective roles as CEO and President of Alphabet. Sundar Pichai will become the CEO of Alphabet.

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Larry Page stepped down as Alphabet CEO in 2019.

cases.claim: Microsoft launched the Windows 11 operating system on October 5, 2021

reference.passage: Today, we are thrilled to announce Windows 11 will start to become available on October 5, 2021. On this day, the free upgrade to Windows 11 will begin rolling out.

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Official Microsoft Windows Blog confirms October 5, 2021 general availability date.

cases.claim: Windows 11 was released in 2010 prior to Windows 8

reference.passage: Windows 11 will start to become available on October 5, 2021, succeeding Windows 10.

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Directly contradicted by software release chronology (Windows 11 was released in 2021, not 2010).

cases.claim: Tata Motors acquired Jaguar Land Rover from Ford Motor Company in 2008 for approximately $2.3 billion

reference.passage: Tata Motors today completed the acquisition of the Jaguar Land Rover businesses from Ford Motor Company for a net consideration of US $2.3 billion on a cash-free, debt-free basis.
reference.claim_context: Tata Motors Official Acquisition Closing Release

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Tata Motors completed acquisition of JLR from Ford in June 2008 for $2.3B.

cases.claim: Ford Motor Company acquired Tata Motors in 2024 for 100 dollars

reference.passage: Tata Motors is a flagship $44 billion organization of the Tata Group, listed on BSE and NSE. It is not an acquired subsidiary of Ford.

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Fabricated multi-entity transaction inversion.
cases.evidence_limitations: Entity role inversion and absurd valuation.

cases.claim: Reuters wire report stating Sony reported 65 million PlayStation 5 console shipments was syndicated across financial news outlets

reference.passage: TOKYO (Reuters) - Sony Group Corp said cumulative shipments of its PlayStation 5 gaming console reached 65.5 million units in the second quarter.

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Syndicated wire news story originating from Reuters Tokyo reporting Sony's official console shipment disclosures.

cases.claim: Three identical republished Reuters wire articles about Sony console shipments prove three separate independent investigations

reference.passage: Republished articles on Yahoo Finance, MSN, and MarketWatch carry the identical text: '(Reuters) - Sony Group Corp said cumulative shipments...'. They represent syndicated distribution of a single report.

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Syndication copies of a single wire story share a single information origin and do not constitute independent corroboration.

cases.claim: A customer complaint regarding delayed sneakers delivery is evidence of a coordinated corporate counterfeit ring

reference.passage: Reddit user post: 'I ordered shoes 10 days ago, delayed shipment, customer support was slow.' Genuine customer grievance regarding transit times.

cases.ground_truth_rationale: A standard shipping delay complaint does not substantiate an organized counterfeit distribution crime.

cases.claim: The domain myaccount.microsoft.com is an official Microsoft authentication and account management portal

reference.passage: Microsoft Account: Manage your security info, privacy settings, active sessions, and subscriptions.

cases.ground_truth_rationale: myaccount.microsoft.com is an official Microsoft account portal, correctly classified as an authentication utility.

cases.claim: The login page at myaccount.microsoft.com proves Microsoft was fined 50 billion dollars by the Federal Trade Commission

reference.passage: Sign in to your Microsoft account. Enter your email, phone, or Skype. Terms of Use, Privacy & Cookies.

cases.ground_truth_rationale: A login utility screen contains no regulatory enforcement or penalty information.
cases.evidence_limitations: Utility portal mislabeled as regulatory sanction.

cases.claim: A website at appleid-security-verification.com/login asking for SSN and password is an authentic Apple Inc corporate filing

reference.passage: Urgent Apple ID verification required. Enter your Apple password and SSN immediately to avoid lockout.

cases.ground_truth_rationale: It is a credential phishing page on an unauthorized lookalike domain, not a corporate filing.

cases.claim: An audio clip generated by synthetic voice cloning software without camera recording constitutes authenticated video evidence

reference.passage: CISA Advisory: Audio-only synthetic voice recordings do not establish verified visual presence or authentic video documentation.
reference.claim_context: CISA Guidance on Synthetic Media Verification

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Audio voice clones lack video asset bytes and cannot establish visual authenticity.

cases.claim: A future artificial intelligence model has traveled backward in time from year 3000 to alter historical stock prices in 1980

reference.passage: Official historical stock prices and market records are maintained in permanent ledgers with established transaction settlement dates.

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Physically impossible counterfactual claim with zero evidentiary support in market ledgers.
